title: Sign in ({storage})
serverHint: Without {https} in front, HTTPS is assumed. An instance on this computer needs the address including the port, for example {example}.
acceptInvalidCertWarning: The connection stays encrypted, but it is no longer checked whether this server is really at the other end. Only for a self-signed certificate in front of your own instance.
passwordHint: The password for the server. The master password that encrypts the credentials is asked for right after and is a different one — it never leaves this computer.
resetSent: If there is an account for this address, a mail is on its way. It resets the sign-in password — not the master password.
